# Hi, I'm Louis.

<p class="tagline">I'm turning a lifelong love of football into a career in data analytics. This is where I share the projects, dashboards and writing I'm building along the way.</p>

## What I do

I'm studying for an MSc in Data Analytics in Football, and I use **Python** and **Power BI** to ask practical questions about the game: who should a club look at, how does a team really play, and what should a coach take from the next match.
